ns2:course.label: Ugrad Bioinformatics Seminar
ns2:course.description: Introduces the field of bioinformatics and computational biology. Same as CPSC 491. 0 to 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms to maximum of 2 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
